extension_engineering_tradeoff: Terminal biomass amount (a) and volume (b) for the best recorded feasible policy in each of four initial conditions and three composition targets. The dashed line is the volume cap; connecting lines guide the eye.
extension_biomass_all_cases: Terminal biomass amount in the twelve target cases. Symbols identify the three algorithm seeds; horizontal marks show medians. D1: direct single start; D3: direct multistart; DB: database; QR: quadratic surrogate; NN: neural surrogate. DB, QR and NN include mechanistic correction.
extension_evaluations_complete_cost: Mechanistic evaluations per run (a) and total measured cost for 36 decisions per method (b). Stacks separate online calculation, label generation and fitting. The DB marker gives the training-only cost alternative.
extension_initial_condition_sensitivity: Fixed-policy response to four combinations of ±5% initial composition and glucose perturbations: number of corners satisfying the acceptance rules (a) and maximum relative composition error (b).
